decisions.reason: The client explicitly establishes that each website retains the shared structure while its branding and wording are customized, broadening brand presentation to the location sites.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: It's really one type of website that stays the same throughout all the websites—we copy and paste it and just change the branding and wording. All packages and prices stay the same.

value_updates.location_site_branding_and_wording: Customize the branding and wording for each website while retaining the shared website structure.

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message INTRODUCE capturing that packages and prices remain consistent across location websites.
Sharing a layout template across websites does not change which legacy content and images are reused for migration.
The source does not change the master domain or any domain-to-website mapping.
The shared template decision does not alter how the master site lists locations or routes visitors to them.
The source does not change Harbor Valley site availability or its linkage from the master site.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording reuse of the website structure with location-specific branding and wording.
Using the same template across websites does not change the established model in which each location has its own Wix website.
The source does not change separate revenue, sales, or reporting behavior for each location.
The source does not change where bookings occur or the requirement that bookings remain isolated by location.
The shared template, branding, package, and pricing statements do not modify the SEO migration and ranking-preservation requirements.
A common website structure does not change the requirement for each location to retain its own Wix account.
